name: my-module
description: Tests and checks for the My Module Foundry VTT module (the module itself needs no install step).

scripts.check: for f in scripts/*.mjs tests/*.mjs $(ls tools/*.mjs 2>/dev/null); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run types && npm test && npm run core:verify
